Researchers have discovered a vulnerability in Unisoc modems — components found in many budget Android devices — that can be exploited through video calls to compromise a phone without any action from the user. Separately, a new Linux-based botnet called Evooo1Bot is expanding beyond typical denial-of-service attacks, posing broader risks to internet-connected devices including routers and servers. Australian organisations using budget Android devices or Linux-based infrastructure should be aware of these emerging threats.

A US lawsuit also highlighted a cautionary tale for Australian workplaces: an expert witness used ChatGPT to write a professional report, raising serious concerns about AI-generated content being passed off as authoritative work. With a recent study showing only 5% of staff use generative AI effectively, it's a timely reminder to verify any AI-assisted work before sharing it externally.
